text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm walking around with
Aston
Machan...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! A crown-shaped cookie
eating
contest to determine the
champion? What an
idea!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Watch in awe as I consume more than
anyone
else! How can I be so sure of my
success, you ask?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why, speak of crowns and who else
comes to
mind but yours truly? For I am
the king of
kings—the Centurial
Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I can't take that sitting down.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My crown is one of my most charming
features as
a super ultra mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I have to make sure it's my name that
people
think of when they see a crown!
Bring on the
cookies!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: レースへの影響は、大丈夫？

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Right. This is a crucial time for me. I have
to be
strict about my carrot intake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan ultimately decides not to

participate in the eating contest.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. After all, crowns are happy
sitting on
Machan's head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So Machan goes ahead and enters the

crown-shaped cookie eating contest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the other contestants fall by the
wayside and
forfeit, Aston Machan and
T.M. Opera O eat on
and on...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, hehe... You're really... putting
those cookies
away!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, heh... That's because... I'm going
to
become... a super ultra mascot, so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, they both reach their limits

simultaneously, and the crowning of a
winner is
deferred to the next contest.
